Communications Equipment.name: 3-MAL Secure Comlink
Communications Equipment.ability: Comlink transmit up to medium range on the planetary scale. Encryption adds ⬛ to any check made to intercept and unscramble the signal. Monitoring a standard clear frequency on civilized worlds can add ⬛⬛ to Knowledge checks related to current events or conditions at the GM's discretion

Communications Equipment.name: Atgar Artillery Remote
Communications Equipment.ability: A character can link a single Gunnery weapon to an Atgar Artillery Remote with a Hard(ddd) Computers check or a Average (dd) Computers check  if the weapon is Atgar Spacedefense corporation model. Linked weapon gains the Inaccurate 2 quality and the holder of the remote can fire the weapon from up to medium range.

Communications Equipment.name: Collar-Amp
Communications Equipment.ability: Allows users voice to be heard up to long or extreme range (dependant on terrain and other environmental conditions), add 100 credits for a version that hooks into sound systems or entertainment sound systems which improves sound quality

Communications Equipment.name: Comlink (Handheld)
Communications Equipment.ability: Allows communication up to distances around 100 kilometres

Communications Equipment.name: Comlink (Long Range)
Communications Equipment.ability: Allows communication across a planet, to orbiting structures, and possibly interplanetary (within the same star system)

Communications Equipment.name: DH77 Headcomm
Communications Equipment.ability: Subject to interference from explosions, ion engines and jamming, constant shifting encryption adds ⬛⬛⬛ to any attempt to intercept and unscramble the signal

Communications Equipment.name: Encryption Module
Communications Equipment.ability: Attaches to comlinks or hypertranscivers to encode messages sent, much larger and more sophisticated than a simple comm scrambler the encryption module uses extremely complex algorithms and ciphers to code transmissions. It is nearly impossible to break the codes used so it requires a decryption key to understand but attempts can still be made with a Formidable (ddddd) computers check and also requires proper equipment such as a ship's mainframe or a class one droid.

Communications Equipment.name: False Voice Transmitter
Communications Equipment.ability: Provided a good voice sample, can replicate any voice. When impersonating another individual the user can upgrade the ability of his Charm, Coercion, Deception, Leadership and Negotiation checks once.

Communications Equipment.name: Shockhold Hardened Comlink
Communications Equipment.ability: Planet-wide and planet to orbit communications with military grade encryption, adds an automatic ff to decode and a automatic ss to any checks made to broadcast through a com jammer (FaD:Knights of fate version says only one s and only one f)
Communications Equipment.source:
Dangerous Covenants (Hired Gun Sourcebook)
Knights of Fate

Communications Equipment.name: Holo-Messenger
Communications Equipment.ability: Used mostly for messages. Plays a holographic recording or transmission.

Communications Equipment.name: HoloNet Relay
Communications Equipment.ability: Allows user to communicate with the HoloNet (it is highly regulated and mostly militarized by the empire though) can be blocked by jamming and/or environmental factors.

Communications Equipment.name: Hyper transceiver
Communications Equipment.ability: Able to transmit up to 100 light years, normally used for ships sending messages or distress signals.

Communications Equipment.name: Intergraded Public Address System
Communications Equipment.ability: Loudspeaker installed in a backpack or carrying case for addressing large crowds anywhere

Communications Equipment.name: PTP Link
Communications Equipment.ability: Lower tech communication range of 25 kilometres. A encryption device can be purchased for 1,000 credits for near undetectable transmission of messages

Communications Equipment.name: Remote Activation Controller (Long range)
Communications Equipment.ability: Activates a vehicle or starship and starts pre-flight checks so user can make a quick getaway

Communications Equipment.name: Remote Activation Controller (Short range)
Communications Equipment.ability: Activates a vehicle or starship and starts pre-flight checks so user can make a quick getaway

Communications Equipment.name: Verpine Comlink
Communications Equipment.ability: Picks up on Verpine telepathic communications and can broadcast secret messages using said link, range 100 kilometres.

Communications Equipment.name: Com-Scan
Communications Equipment.ability: A character can Triangulate the location and movement of a known comlink or transceiver with an Average (dd) Computers check. The device functions out to close range on planetary scale. Prevailing atmospheric conditions or excessive background signals can reduce its efficacy.

Communications Equipment.name: Earbud Comlink
Communications Equipment.ability: Activated by touching ones ear, or clicking ones teeth, This has a far shorter range than of a normal commlink due to tiny power cell and can only work to a maximum range of long, Noticing someone wearing a earbud comlink requires a Hard (ddd) Perception check.

Communications Equipment.name: Holo-Megacaster
Communications Equipment.ability: Projects a large holographic version of the user up to 10 meters in height, normally used for addressing large crowds. A Character using a Holo-Megacaster adds  to Presence-based checks to address a crowd and allows the users image and voice to be seen and heard clearly up to extreme range.

Drugs and Poisons.name: Antidote Set
Drugs and Poisons.ability: When used reduce the difficulty of any check to resist a poison by two (to a minimum of Easy (d)), if character does not know what poison was used he/she must make a Hard  (ddd) Knowledge (Underworld) check to make a educated guess on the poison to benefit from this item

Drugs and Poisons.name: Dendriton Toxin (1 dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Has a Daunting (dddd) difficulty, if the target fails the check the poison inflicts 1 strain at the end of his next turn, 3 strain at the end of the subsequent turn and 5 strain at the turn after that one (ignoring soak) in addition the target suffers ⬛ to any check he attempts under the effects of the poison, each t he generates on those checks inflicts 1 additional strain (ignores soak), The GM may spend y on the initial Resilience check to make the target make another check against the poison at the end of his third turn or suffer an additional 5 strain
Drugs and Poisons.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Drugs and Poisons.name: Dioxis Gas (1 dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: A single dose has a Hard (ddd) difficulty, 2 or more doses have a Daunting                        (dddd) difficulty, if the target fail the check the poison inflicts 5 wounds (ignoring soak) in addition each t generated inflicts 2 strain on the target (ignores soak), target becomes overwhelmed by nausea and muscle spasms cause by the choking gas. Gas lingers in the air for up to 3 rounds unless dissipated by high winds
Drugs and Poisons.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Drugs and Poisons.name: Poisoner's Ring
Drugs and Poisons.ability: As an action make a opposed Skulduggery check against any onlookers' Vigilance to deposit one dose of any GM approved poison to a targets meal of beverage without being noticed

Drugs and Poisons.name: Raquor Venom (1 dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Has a Daunting (dddd) difficulty, if the target fails the check the poison staggers the target for 2 rounds and for each t generated inflicts 2 strain on the target (ignores soak), GM may spend y to Immobilize the target for 2 rounds. Can be Liquid or Gas (gas reducing the difficulty by one)
Drugs and Poisons.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Drugs and Poisons.name: Synthetic Anaesthetic (1 dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Used to render subject unconscious, a single dose has an Average (dd) difficulty check while two ore more doses have a Hard (ddd) difficulty check. The poison inflicts 5 strain if the target fails the check, if the check generates one or two t , the target must also give up his free manoeuvre during his next turn, if three or more t is generated he/she is staggered during his/her next turn, Finally the GM can spend y to make the target test against the poison again during the next round to see if the poison remains in the subjects system

Drugs and Poisons.name: Synthetic Neuropralytic (1 dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Immobilizes the target, any dosage size has a Hard (ddd) difficulty check, if the target fails the check they are immobilized for three rounds, in addition on each t generated 1 strain is inflicted on the target, the GM can spend y to make the target test against the poison again during the next round

Drugs and Poisons.name: Synthetic Neurotoxin (1 dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: If the target fails a Average (dd) check for a single dose or a Hard (ddd) check for multiple doses, the target suffers 5 wounds, in addition for each t one strain is suffered, the GM may spend one y to have the target test against the poison during the next round.

Drugs and Poisons.name: SleepPack (1 Dose)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: If target is aware and unwilling the wielder must make a Hard (ddd) Brawl or  Melee combat check against the target instead of inflicting damage, if successful the target must immediately resist the effects of the medications that flood the system as a poison (with a Resilience check). Any sized dose has a Hard (ddd) difficulty and failure inflicts 10 strain.

Drugs and Poisons.name: Sulfer Inhaler (10 Doses)
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Only effective for Devaronians. As a manoeuvre inhale a does of the drug, the character suffers 2 strain and adds ⬛ to any Brawn or Agility he makes until the end of the encounter. Additional doses inflict more strain but do not give additional bonuses. Unpleasant for non-Devaronians

Drugs and Poisons.name: Affide Crystal
Drugs and Poisons.ability: (Suicide pill usually in a false tooth) This is a poison that requires a upgraded Daunting cddd Resilience check to overcome when ingested. The poison inflicts 10 wounds and a Critical Injury on a failed check. Each t generated adds +40 to the roll for the Critical Injury result. Gms may spend ttt or y to kill a target instantly, leaving no opportunity for resuscitation.

Drugs and Poisons.name: Cyanoxis D-570
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Administered through food and/or drink, once ingested the poison usually takes about a week to kill. A character who has injested this can make a hard ddd resilience check to overcome. On a failed check, the poison inflicts 2 wounds and 2 strain immediately, plus 1 wound and 1 strain per day for ten days or until the target succumbs to death. Each t generated inflicts 1 additional strain per day. y can be spent to increase the number of days the poison stays in effect by one.

Drugs and Poisons.name: Skirtopanol
Drugs and Poisons.ability: Requires a hard ddd Resilience check to overcome. On a failed check, the drug inflicts 5 strain and the difficulty of all checks the target makes to resist charm or coercion for the remainder of the encounter is upgraded once. In addition, each t generated on the original check inflicts 2 strain on the target. finally, the GM can spend y to make the target check against the drug again during the next round as it remains in their system.

Drugs and Poisons.name: Vutalamine
Drugs and Poisons.ability: known as "Vue,"a single dose lasts 24 hours, during that time the character upgrades the ability of any checks made to resist stress or fear once. In addition the difficulty of ranged (light) and ranged (heavy) checks made at long or extreme range is reduced by one. at the GMs discretion, frequent use can lead to impaired judgement and memory loss, imposing a permanent ⬛ on Intellect and Cunning based checks

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Arms (mod V and VI)
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Mod V Cyberarms provide +1 Brawn, while Mod VI Cyberarms provide +1 Agility. If replacing both arms they must both be the same Mod and stat modifiers do not stack

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Brain Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides +1 Intellect, Comes with Commlink and Computer access link

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Eyes
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides +1 Vigilance and Perception

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Legs (Mod II and III)
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Mod II Cyberlegs provide +1 Brawn and Mod III cyberlegs provide +1 agility. BOTH legs must be replaced to receive these benefits.

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Weapon Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Houses a retractable light blaster pistol that cannot be dropped, removed or disarmed

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cyber scanner Limb
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Medium range detection showing nearby motion, lifeforms, energy signatures and other common targets as desired

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Immune Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides wearer +1 Resilience

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Implant Armour
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides +1 Soak

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Prosthetic Replacement (Limb)
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Replaces a lost limb

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Prosthetic Replacement (Organ)
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Replaces a lost organ

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Neuro-Saav Cyborg/Droid Interface
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Direct connection to a droids communication port. When hooked up to a hostile droid upgrade the ability of all its computer checks once when attempting to access information

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Swift 78B Vessel Courier System
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Used to transport sensitive data in a small dataport that is secured usually beneath the courier's hairline secured by synthflesh.

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Appraiser's Eye
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Adds an automatic a on negotiation and streetwise checks to buy or sell items

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Cavity
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides 1 rank of the Hidden Storage talent

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Digital Lockpick
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: provides 1 rank of the Bypass Security talent

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Adrenal Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides 1 rank of the Rapid Recover Talent
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Reflexes
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides 1 rank of the Rapid Reaction Talent
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cybernetic Respirator
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides user the same benefits of a breath mask and respirator and adds 1 rank of the Blooded Talent
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Gank Comm Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Inaudible communication with other units, can be subject to jamming
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Implanted Cyberjack
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: once per check, a character with an implanted cyberjack may suffer 2 strain to decrease the difficulty of a Computers check to disable a security device or slice into a computers system by one.
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Neuromachine Interface
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Allows control of a vehicle by thought, vehicle must have a control device installed, pilot using this link may use his coordination skill in place of the pilot (Planetary/Space) skill
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Q-22 Retinal Tracker
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides an automatic a on gunnery and Ranged (Heavy) checks.
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Repulsor Fist
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides one rank in the Defensive Stance talent and counts as a Brawl weapon with a Damage of 8, Critical of 3, and the Concussive 1 and Slow-Firing 2 qualities, can only be used once every 3rd round otherwise the repulsor fist acts as a normal unarmed melee attack.
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.source: Lords of Nal Hutta (Hutt Space Sourcebook)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Biofeedback Regulator
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Increases the characters cybernetic implant cap by two. Does not count to implant cap. Limit 1 Regulator per person. Droids unable to use

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Escape Circuit
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: (Droids only) Resisting a restraining bolt now only requires a Easy (d) Discipline check instead of the normal difficulty. The droid may spend aa from a check made to resist a restraining bolt to overload the bold rendering it entirely useless

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Networked Slicing uplink
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: (Droids only) Counts as a set of slicer gear. When droid is slicing or assisting with slicing tasks, add ⬛ to Computers check to identify the user slicer based on these activities, such as Trace user action.

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Neural Recorder
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Make a Easy (d)Discipline check to recall information gained while the recorder was running. Recorded data can be copied to a more common external storage device using a included connection port

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Surge Override Switch
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Once per encounter a character can make a Average (dd) Discipline check to reactivate any number of cybernetic implants that have been overloaded by Ion weapons. Each reactivated implant causes 2 strain to the user

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Avionics Interface
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Requires at least 1 rank in piloting (Planetary) and/or (Space) gains +1 rank to the appropriate piloting skill when flying a starship or airspeeder..

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cortex Bomb
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Upon hearing, seeing or speaking a pre-determined code a person with a implanted cortex bomb will be killed, this does no damage to the surrounding area…. Anyone watch that movie "Scanners (1981)"

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Cyber Disguise
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability:
Gives advantages of a disguise kit, also grants user two ranks in Indistinguishable. This can change general features like eye or hair colour and even skin colour (do the whole Michael Jackson thing) grow hair and/or beard, With the GMs permission one could even impersonate someone of another similar shaped species (human, chiss, pantoran) it cannot change physical attributes like number of arms, size, horns. 
To impersonate a specific person (provided they are of similar size and shape) one must make a thorough study of the subject then make a Hard (ddd) Deception check to set the disguise.
Changing can take up to 1 to 3 rounds, the more detailed the disguise the longer it takes either minutes or hours.

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Lockbreaker Hand
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides a rank in Bypass Security Talent and adds ⬛ to Skulduggery and Computers checks made to defeat locks

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Multi-Tool Hand
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Provides all the benefits of a tool kit "Go go gadget screwdriver"

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Pain Damper
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Upgrade the ability of all checks made to resist pain or physical torture once.

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Retinal Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: With a few minutes of studying a retinal pattern and a Average(ddd) Perception check, Retinal implants can fool most retina scanners with an Easy (d) Cool Check, More advanced scanners can have a increased difficulty up to a maximum of Hard (ddd)

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Vessel Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Subdermal data storage, with a fiber optic cable that can plug into nearly any datapad or computer, the implant is non networked and can not be sliced unless user is incapacitated of the implant is removed, Finding a vessel implant on a character requires a Daunting (dddd) Perception check

Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.name: Vocal Emulator Implant
Cybernetic Enhancements and Replacements.ability: Changing or disguising a characters voice takes one round, to mimic the voice of a specific individual the user must make a intensive study of the subject by listening to recordings, hearing the individual deliver a long speech etc. and make a Hard (ddd) Deception Check to nail down the individuals voice, speech patterns and inotations.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Electrobinoculars
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Long distance or Low light Perception checks to identify an object may remove ⬛ from the check

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: General Purpose Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Detect motion up to long distance; life-forms, energy signals and other common targets up to extreme distance / Intercept comlink transmissions

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Hand Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Detect detailed information about target or surroundings such as poisons, weaknesses, etc. up to short distance.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Macrobionoculars
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Magnify targets up to 10 km.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Scanner Goggles
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: "When worn, scanner goggles allow the wearer to see normally in dark conditions." Its suggested for balance to replace that to this "Remove ⬛ due to low or poor light."

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Surveillance Tagger
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Must be physically attached to target. Detect targets location, direction and rate of movement up to around 100 km

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Authentication Tools
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: A character using Authentication tools adds ⬛⬛ to checks to determine if a document has been falsified

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Concealed Recorder
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Add ⬛⬛ To a character's Perception checks to find a concealed recorder on a person's body

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Security Sweeper
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Make a Average (dd) Computers check to detect an area for any espionage tools and its location, if well hidden make a opposed Mechanics skill of the one who placed the device

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Combat Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Allows user to see normally in dark conditions and can track motion, heat and metal, adds ⬛⬛ to any checks made to attempt to decode and understand transmissions from the combat scanner to other combat scanners (FaD:Knights of fate version says remove ⬛⬛ to checks due to darkness)
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.source:
Dangerous Covenants (Hired Gun Sourcebook)
Knights of Fate (Warrior Sourcebook)

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Demolitions Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Allows user to detect concealed explosive devices and adds ⬛ to any checks to do so

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Recon Remote
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Remote droid used for Recon and surveillance, 20 kilometre range.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Long-Range Terrain Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Requires a Average (dd) Computers check on the part of the operator. Maps produced add ⬛ to any survival check made to navigate using the map plus an automatic s for every two a gained on the computers check

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Ground-Penetrating Sensor Pack
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Used to find things underground

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Life Form Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Detects up to half a kilometre away for lifeforms, Requires either an Average (dd) Survival Check or a Hard (ddd) Education or computers check to ensure the device is properly calibrated

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Hunting Goggles
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Grant ⬛ to any Perception skill checks made to locate prey. Removes ⬛⬛ imposed due to concealment, darkness or fog and mist from all Ranged (Light) and (Heavy) checks

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Forensic Kit
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Adds an automatic s to all Perception checks made by the user to spot and gather evidence.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Holoscanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Reduce the difficulty of Perception or Vigilance checks to discover concealed items on a person or in a container or vehicle by two, typically a scanner cannot scan an item or group of items with an encumbrance higher then its own

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Hyperwave Signal Interceptor
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Range of 10 light years, can pickup and receive hyper communications and detect the smallest fluctuations in hyperspace, skilled operators can track vessels through hyperspace, providing several minutes warning prior to a ship exiting or giving the user a fairly good idea of the general course and direction of a vessel in hyperspace.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Weapon Detection Goggles
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Add ⬛⬛ To a character's Perception checks to find a concealed weapon on a person's body

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: PX-7 Heat Sensor
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: A PX 7 heat sensor adds ⬛⬛ to Perception checks to find heat-emitting objects within short range and adds ⬛ to Mechanics checks to remove Critical Hits from starships and Critical Injuries from droids.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Veridicator 200
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: A character wearing a Veridicator 200 adds ⬛⬛ to checks to discern whether another character is lying or omitting significant information and adds ⬛⬛  to checks to ascertain another character's mental state

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Low Feedback Scanner
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Detects radiation sources of silhouette of 1 or larger within a short range, life forms within medium range, power sources within long range and Comms signals within extreme range. Extend the range of detection by 1 range for every silhouette size by which the target's size exceeds silhouette 1.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: SE-Vigilant Automated Sensor
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: 1.6 meter collapsible post with sensors, first detects audio and visual and once it senses something it triggers a second scan commences with infrared, electromagnetic and other forms of scanning and relays the data to the users datapad. Can be left to operate by itself for long periods of time due to use of a solar panel.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Infrabinoculars
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: A character using Infrabinoculars can see through up to two meters of wall, possibly allowing surveillance of a whole building at once. Walls made of dense materials or constructed to shield their interiors may impose one or more  on Perception checks to see inside, at GM's discretion

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Infrabinoculars (with Long-Range sensors)
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: A character using Infrabinoculars can see through up to two meters of wall, possibly allowing surveillance of a whole building at once. Walls made of dense materials or constructed to shield their interiors may impose one or more  on Perception checks to see inside, at GM's discretion. Can also be switched to a long range view equivalent  to that of electrobinoculars.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Microdroid Listener
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Can follow a set of pre-programmed instructions from their owner, returning after a set period of time or upon detection of a specific keyword or audio cue. The microdroid does not broadcast their surveillance data and they can be quite difficult to detect until they return. Planting this device without being noticed requires an opposed Skulduggery vs Vigilance check, Once in place a character must make a Daunting (dddd) Vigilance check to locate it even when she is specifically searching for one. Has a self destruct mode in case of tampering.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: TaggeCo Privacy 7 Audio Curtain
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability:
Device comprises of two matched rods, Users can plant the rods onto nearly any horizontal surface in order to create a sound-dampening field between them, multiple sets of rods can enclose a conversation or the user can place them at a physical gap such as an open door or the entry to an enclosed booth at a tapcafe.

Characters attempting to listen in on a conversation which is being obscured by one or more audio curtains must make a Hard (ddd) Perception check to understand anything being said, The GM can spend t or y to have the character misunderstand key words or phrases

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: BioScan
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Using a Bioscan to scan an area for life signs grants  to any Perception checks opposing Stealth. Using the device to verify a person's identity requires an Average (dd) Computers check and a biometric identifier for comparison. The GM may modify this difficulty based upon any unusual anatomical characteristics of the target's species

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: HoloNet Homing Beacon
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Can be attached to any ship, so long as the device is not noticed and removed or if the ship is traveling outside known systems the owner of the Homing Beacon can track the ship with no checks required.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Tracker's Goggles
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Grant ⬛ to any Perception skill checks made to locate prey. Removes ⬛⬛ imposed due to concealment, darkness or fog and mist from all Ranged (Light) and (Heavy) checks

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Applied Imaging B310 Micro-Imager
Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: A Micro imager adds ⬛⬛ to any Perception, Knowledge (Lore) or Knowledge (Education) checks for which magnification of fine details can contribute to the research at hand.

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.name: Dalabar SDS-632 Surveillance Detector

Scanning, Detection and Surveillance Equ.ability: Used to check rooms for bugs or search for hidden observers or electronic surveillance, can detect and locate comms signals, electromagnetic fields, ect. Medical Equipment.ability: (Unknown)

Medical Equipment.name: Cerebral Stabilizer
Medical Equipment.ability: Apply to a patient within one round of suffering a critical injury, may be applied to a character suffering from a "Bleeding Out" or "The End is Nigh" critical injury or even a character who has died during the current round. Applying the device requires an Average (dd) Medicine check. Once applied the character is stabilized, if he died he is brought back to life and counts as suffering a gruesome injury (and all its effects) otherwise the critical injury effects are cancelled, though he suffers from the injury himself

Medical Equipment.name: Military Medpac
Medical Equipment.ability: If user has no ranks in Medicine the user counts as having 1 rank in medicine when using this medpack, also removes medicine check penalty.

Medical Equipment.name: Medical Backpack
Medical Equipment.ability: Allows characters to use the Medicine skill to heal others without penalty. Grants ⬛ to all Medicine checks made using Medical Backpack and decreases the difficulty of any Medicine checks to heal Critical Injuries by 1 to a minimum of Easy (d)

Medical Equipment.name: Blood Scanner
Medical Equipment.ability: As an action. a character with a blood scanner may make an Easy (d) Medicine check to identify foreign elements (including poisons) in a blood sample. In addition to allowing the character to treat any present toxins with the proper antidote. The extensive information about the patient's health adds automatic aa to the next Medicine check the character makes to treat the patient.

Medical Equipment.name: Med-Aid Patch
Medical Equipment.ability: When making a Medicine check to heal wounds from a character. A character can expend up to one med-aid patch to add automatic s+a to the results of the check. A character cannot use more than one med-aid patch per check.

Medical Equipment.name: Nullicaine
Medical Equipment.ability: Character may apply Nullicaine to themselves or an engaged character by making an Easy (d) Medicine check and choosing 1 Easy (d), Average (dd) or Hard (ddd) Critical injury the target is currently suffering, if successful target suffers 3 strain and ignores the chosen critical injury until the end of the encounter

Medical Equipment.name: Stimstick
Medical Equipment.ability: A character who chews a stimstick removes ⬛ from their discipline, Perception, Resilience or Vigilance checks to stay awake or notice something due to fatigue or lack of sleep until the end of the encounter, at the end of the encounter the character suffers 1 strain.

Medical Equipment.name: Military Traumapac
Medical Equipment.ability: A traumapac only allows a character to use the Medicine skill to attempt to remove Critical Injuries from others without penalty.

Medical Equipment.name: Healer's Kit
Medical Equipment.ability: Must be made by the character with a Hard (ddd) Survival check.  Allows the character to use the medicine skill to heal themselves or others without penalty. GM may spend y on a Medicine check when a character is using a healer's kit to indicate that some or all of the medicinal items have been exhausted and the kit cannot be used again until restocked with a  Average (dd) Survival Check.

Medical Equipment.name: XV-20 Portable Veterinary Kit
Medical Equipment.ability: Allows an individual to treat a wounded or ill creature without penalty. Additionally the kit gains ⬛ to all medicine, survival and knowledge (xenology) skill checks made to diagnose or treat such animals

Medical Equipment.name: Antishock Blanket

Medical Equipment.name: Bioscan

Medical Equipment.name: Plasma Protein Replicator
Medical Equipment.ability: When a character uses a plasma protein replicator to help heal a Critical Injury, the character adds automatic s to the Medicine check made to heal the injury

Medical Equipment.name: Spray Plasto-Cast
Medical Equipment.ability: A character can make an Easy (d) Medicine check to apply a spray plasto-cast to a limb that has been crippled or disabled due to a critical injury. If successful  the critical injury heals automatically after one week of narrative time.

Medical Equipment.name: Toxin Detector
Medical Equipment.ability: detects toxins and poisons in food, drink and even in the environment, Simple red/green indicators or subtle vibration to alert user to presence of dangerous substances, often built into bracelets or other jewellery for maximum subtlety.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: "Knack" Restraining Bolt

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: AL-DR8 Grav-Binders
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Breaking free from grav binders requires a Formidable (ddddd) Athletics check (due to the restrictive effects of the artificially raised gravity on the whole body, a character cannot slip free of gravbinders using flexibility alone).

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Binders
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Requires a Daunting (dddd) Athletics or Coordination check to escape

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: BlackOps/Outlaw Data Breaker

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Falsified Credentials
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Characters using scanners require a successful Hard (ddd) Computers check to recognize credentials as fake ( or a Daunting (dddd) Perception check without equipment)

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Fingerprint Masque
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Depending on the scanner checking the fingerprints may fool scanner with any Cool or Deception check at GMs discretion up to Hard (ddd) depending on how advanced the scanner is, if biometric scanner operator has reason to be suspicious it may require a opposed social skill check vs the operator's computers skill. Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Requires a Formidable (ddddd) Coordination Check, they are too strong to break though brute force

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Personal Transponder
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Picking up a personal Transponder's signal accurately enough to find its exact location within close range on planetary scale requires an Average (dd) Computers Check. Increase the difficulty of this check by two for each planetary scale range band beyond close, to a maximum of extreme range at the planetary scale.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Restraining Bolt
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Works on NPC's, But PCs can make a Daunting (dddd) Discipline check to shake off the effects

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Scramble Key
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Attempts to guess an access code at incredible speeds to gain access  through a electronic lock (simple locks within 5 minutes of application, more complicated locks at GM's discretion adding more time and/or triggering relevant alarms). Users may attempt to speed up the process with a Daunting (dddd) Skulduggery check  relying on pure intuition to select the correct code, failure immediately triggers any relevant alarms. Force-sensitive characters may make a force power check as part of this check adding either s or a for each 🌓 generated

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Shadowcloak
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Discerning any identifiable features of a character wearing a shadowcloak requires a Daunting (dddd) Perception Check | (Cyphers and mask info follows); works best when static, normally attached to chairs/furniture, can operate for an hour but then has to cool of for four, if wearer has performed a move manoeuvre in the round (or was moved by some other means) the check to discern features is reduced to Hard (ddd)

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Skifter

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Stun Cuffs

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Collar Requires a Daunting (dddd) Skulduggery check to remove without the key, if character fails the wearer suffers 2 strain and 1 wound (ignores soak) and becomes Disoriented for 5 rounds.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Holographic Disguise Matrix
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: A character using this item can effectively impersonate the visual appearance of whomever the device has previously recorded. This device adds ⬛⬛ to the user's Deception checks to impersonate the target and adds ⬛⬛ to onlookers Perception checks to detect the imposter.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Saline Pump
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Clawdite use only, Add ⬛ to Clawdite's checks to pass as another person using their species ability, and ⬛ to other characters checks to the Clawdite's physiological deception.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Holographic Image Disguiser
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Projects a high resolution, pre-rendered image that completely covers a target, image is very lifelike with movements, breathing, blinking twitchs, but can only be used for one pre-rendered image, droids, cameras and scanners can see through this disguise. Disguise must be the same size as the target or larger, detecting a HID by eye alone requires a Daunting (dddd) Perception Check. Droids or people using mechanical methods of viewing the user only require an Average (dd) Perception Check

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Vid-Vox Scrambler
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Scramblers affect all electronic by jamming audio, video and holographic recording devices within a four meter radius. A Daunting (dddd) Perception check can be made to attempt to overhear a pertinent part of a conversation from within the jamming bubble, using a recording device requires a Daunting (dddd) Computers check, but that will be incomplete or spotty at best, devices outside the bubble cannot detect anything at all.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Concealed Escape Kit
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability:
Normally in the heel/sole of a boot or shoe, it contains multiple tools to help escape small cells or restraints, a typical kit includes wire cutters, durasteel file, a length of slicewire, miniature memory stick, small maps of the area (player should actively update this or be left with a map from somewhere else or even another planet), a single use laser cutter (works for one round or just enough time to cut through a lock or a bar or two).
Upgrade the ability of all mechanics and Skulduggery checks made to escape confinement once.
Most kits in shoes/boots come with a  flexible monoknife that has the following profile: (Melee; Damage +1; Critical 3; Range [Engaged]; Pierce 1).
Upgrade the difficulty of checks to detect a concealed escape kit twice.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Lockpick Set
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Counts as a tool kit for the purposes of opening mechanical and simple electrical locks

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Redirection Crystal

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Destro-6 Demolition Charge
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability:
Setting up one or more Destro-6 charges with the safeties fully engaged requires an Easy (d) Mechanics check and takes five minutes per charge. Disabling the safeties for a batch of charges halves the time required but increases the difficulty of the check to Hard (ddd). The GM may spend ttt or y on any mechanics check using charges with disabled safety features to cause a premature detonation.
When a charge detonates, it deals 20 damage with breach 1 quality to every character and vehicle within short range, each additional charge used increases the base damage by 5

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Republic Insignia/Replica
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: A Character with one or more Republic Insigina's adds ⬛ to checks made to impress or persuade other characters based on their past service, At GM's discretion a character with multiple of these may add an additional ⬛ to such checks. A Genuine Republic insigina cannot be purchased on the open market, however black market replicas can be found, if a replica is examined a successful Hard (ddd) Perception check reveals that they are fake.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Republic Seal of Service
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: Can only be earned (before the fall of the republic), the award has its own transponder so faking one is also impossible. Characters who have been awarded this item add s to all checks involving formal Republic proceedings, proof of identity or verification of past actions, Presenting a Seal of Service may also upgrade the ability of checks the character makes to impress or persuade those loyal to the Republic, at the GM's discretion.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Concealed Recorder
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability: This item can record conversations and is easily concealed as small inconspicuous item like a pendant, stylus, hair clip.

Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.name: Nano-Droids
Security, Infiltration and Espionage Equ.ability:
An expensive way to kill someone guarrenteed to send them out with a bang … because anything these Nano-Droids are in be it a person or something else, explode dealing 20 damage with Breach 1 to everything within short range. These Nano-Droids are invisible to the naked eye and are stored in a "electrolytic transfer fluid".

Add ⬛⬛⬛ to a characters perception check to notice nano-droids, unless the searcher knows to look for them and has an appropriate scanner.

Nano-droids can be reprogrammed to explode when activated (how the book doesnt say but GMs can figure that out)

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: 1.5 litres of liquid can be held and comes equipped with a filtration system

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Protects eyes from sun, wind, dust and other airborne debris.

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.name: Food Preparation System
Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Camping hotplate

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.name: Holographic Ghillie Suit
Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Increases difficulty to locate the wearer by 1 as long as the wearer remains immobile.

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.name: TaunTaun Pup Tent
Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: can ignore temperatures up to -20 degrees

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: rope

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Make survival check, conceal with GM determined difficulty, animal or sentient makes opposed perception check against the survival skill of character who set snare, if undetected fires a powerful stun blast once it enters engaged range automatically hitting and dealing 10 stun damage to targets strain threshold but does not ignore soak, plus 2 additional damage per s scored on the initial survival check

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: No matter the weather environment the inside of this shelter remains a comfortable temperature, packs down to the size of a large datapad

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Anyone or thing coming into contact with the fence suffers the effects of a stun grenade.

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Anyone Searching for an individual with an active distress beacon gains ⬛⬛ to any Perception, Computers or Surveillance checks made in the course of the search

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.name: Field Kitchen
Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Setup takes 30 minutes, once done grants ⬛⬛ to any Survival or Education skill checks made to store, identify, cook or sterilize consumables.

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: Grants ⬛ to any survival skill checks made to harvest meat, organs or bones from a prey animal

Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: As an action. a character may activate an lnstaMist generator to fills an area out to short range of the generator with a heavy fog. Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.name: Jedi Utility Belt
Survival Gear & \"Unique\" Gear.ability: A Jedi utility belt contains a three-day supply of food capsules, an emergency medpac. a Jedi multi-tool, a slim glow rod. a comlink. and an aqua breather. A number of empty pouches are concealed along the belt's interior side. allowing the wearer to hide small items. In addition, a standard lightsaber can be securely hung from the belt for easy access. A frame that can hold two of the following at extra cost.

-Storage Unit (25 credits, Encumbrance -, Rarity 2): This empty module has a variety of pockets and pouches designed to store survival gear, spare blaster gas canisters, power packs, field rations and a variety of other pieces of equipment used by the Rebel Alliance. This unit increases the wearer's encumbrance capacity by 3.
